summary: GitLab + Bitbucket integration passed QA review. Platform auto-detection and multi-platform PR/MR prompts implemented.

checks.name: Platform detection
checks.details: detectGitPlatform() parses git remote origin URL and returns github/gitlab/bitbucket/unknown. Supports GitHub Enterprise, GitLab self-hosted, and Bitbucket Cloud URLs.

checks.name: Default branch detection
checks.details: detectDefaultBranch() reads refs/remotes/origin/HEAD to determine target branch (main/master/etc). Falls back to 'main'. Uses correct project root, not process.cwd().

checks.name: GitHub prompt
checks.details: Existing flow preserved — uses GitHub MCP server's create_pull_request tool. Backward compatible.

checks.name: GitLab prompt
checks.details: Instructs agent to use glab mr create CLI or GitLab API. Target branch auto-detected from origin/HEAD. Creates Merge Request (not PR).

checks.name: Bitbucket prompt
checks.details: Instructs agent to use Bitbucket REST API v2. Repository slug parsed from remote URL.

checks.name: Unknown platform fallback
checks.details: When platform cannot be auto-detected, agent is given generic instructions to create PR with available tools.

checks.name: Platform info storage
checks.details: Platform stored on task metadata for future UI display (using pragmatic as any cast until Task interface is extended).
